name: Portell
label: Portell, Sant Ramon
view: From the top of Portell (Placa Major by the Torre de Guaita, ~660 m) looking south-west (bearing 215 deg) over the village roofs and the Segarra cereal plateau to the Santuari / Convent de Sant Ramon de Portell, 2.2 km away on the same plateau: the convent's east and north faces, the church cimbori and the north facade with its espadanya. Behind it and across the left half, 26-37 km away, the wind farms of the Conca de Barbera uplands line the horizon (red aviation lights at night). Convent 3D-modelled from aerial imagery/OSM and photos and projected along the real view direction at 1 m = 1.35 dp (cimbori + cross about 56 dp, town-landmark tier); far ridge (SRTM) and turbines (OSM positions) in the same angular frame.
landmarks: Santuari / Convent de Sant Ramon de Portell, 'l'Escorial de la Segarra' (1675-1730): cimbori with octagonal drum and open lantern (~36 m, cross ~41 m)
Convent block around the cloister (~48 x 59 m, three storeys, eaves ~12 m) with a small lantern on the north range
Church north facade (pediment, oculus) with the two-bell espadanya
Les Forques / Passanant i Belltall wind farms on the Conca de Barbera uplands (26-37 km SW, about 15 turbines in view)
Rolling cereal fields of the Segarra with holm oaks and a masia
Roofs of Portell in the foreground
